title: Pop Pop Wash Your Hands | Manipuri Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A bubbly Manipuri rhyme about washing your hands with soap bubbles, so the germs say bye bye!
Sing along and learn why clean hands keep us healthy and happy.
A fun little story about a muddy-handed sister and a very lucky pani puri.

Pop pop pop! Chene nakhao lei them them
O, karaba fijbiji mata!
Chup chup panipuri
Yam yam yam, mathoi taba!

Pap pap, khut shunglo
Bulubuluna phaba
Swash, swash, swash, swash
Chelle chelle shinna!

Panipuri thunglе lakna, lakna
Happi madu thunglo da
Hap, hap, hap, hap
Ayo, puri landaba!

Pap pap, khut shunglo
Bulubuluna phaba
Swash, swash, swash, swash
Chelle chelle shinna!

Madu laklе changba irembal bulu
Paiba, paiba thangba
Bai, bai, bai creamshing, bai bai
Pap khanna cream mayam!

Pap pap, khut shunglo
Bulubuluna phaba
Swash, swash, swash, swash
Chelle chelle shinna!

Phaba khut, chelle chelle
Panipuri hai "Ango lak!"
Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch
Yam yam, machao mathak!
